# Realtors of Panama

> Realtors of Panama is a real estate network in Panama that connects people who want to rent, buy, sell or invest with licensed, verified real estate professionals. Every conversation starts on WhatsApp (+507 6854-8420): an assistant answers right away, then a licensed agent takes over to schedule visits to verified homes and guide the client to closing. Service in English and Spanish.

## What we do
- Rentals and sales of apartments, penthouses and houses in Panama City and surrounding areas.
- Owners can publish their property; a licensed agent verifies it at the Public Registry (finca number and location code) before it is shown.
- Licensed real estate professionals in Panama (licence from the Junta Técnica de Bienes Raíces) can apply to join the network.
- Help for expats, investors, companies relocating staff, local families and renters.

## How it works
1. Message us on WhatsApp with what you need (area, budget, dates).
2. You are connected with a licensed, verified agent who knows the area.
3. You visit homes whose availability was confirmed the same day.
4. You close with contract review and your agent beside you.

## Useful facts (general information, not legal advice)
- Panama uses the US dollar.
- Foreigners can own property in Panama City with the same rights as Panamanians; no residency is needed to buy or rent.
- Property transfer tax is 2% of the higher of the sale price or cadastral value.
- On resale, capital gains tax can be paid as 3% of the sale price or 10% of the profit.
- Typical lease: 12 months, with one month's deposit plus the first month to move in.
